change_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, Empower Clinic Services LLC는 503B 제품의 이상사례 보고·사용법 표시가 누락됐고, ISO 5 구역 미생물 검출 후 제품평가와 조사, 동적 연기시험, 환경관리 및 설비 유지관리가 불충분했다. QA는 일탈조사와 품질감독을 확대하고, QC·생산은 환경·무균시험과 공정 준수를 확인해야 하며, 관련 주사제 회수와 다수 제조 로트 영향평가가 필요하다.

impact_summary.value: 무균 구역의 미생물 오염 평가와 공기흐름 확인이 미흡하고 CGMP 관리에도 결함이 있어, 제품의 오염·품질 저하 위험과 503B 면제 요건 미충족에 따른 승인·표시·공급망 보안 요건 적용 문제가 있습니다.

evidence.quote: Therefore, your products intended to be sterile are produced in an environment that may not provide adequate protection against the risk of contamination.

Because your compounded drug products have not met all of the conditions of section 503B, they are not eligible for the exemptions in that section from the FDA approval requirements of section 505, the requirement under section 502(f)(1) that labeling bear adequate directions for use, and the Drug Supply Chain Security Act requirements described in section 582 of the FDCA.

affected_work.value: Empower Pharma의 503B 무균 조제·충전 업무와 ISO 5 구역의 환경 모니터링, 연기시험, 일탈 조사, 제품 영향 평가 및 원료·표시 관리가 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: Your facility’s drug products, such as Pyridoxine HCl (B6) Injection Solution, did not include the following information on the container: 1) information to facilitate adverse event reporting: www.fda.gov/medwatch and 1-800-FDA-1088 and 2) directions for use, including, as appropriate, dosage and administration.

recommendation.value: FDA는 위반 사항을 신속히 시정하고, 각 조치와 재발 방지 단계 및 관련 문서를 서면으로 제출하도록 요구합니다. 또한 경영진의 종합 운영 평가와 무균 공정 검토를 강력히 권고하며, 관련 전문성을 갖춘 제3자 컨설턴트의 지원을 권고합니다.

evidence.quote: You should take prompt action to address any violations. Failure to adequately address any violations may result in legal action without further notice, including, without limitation, seizure and injunction.

FDA strongly recommends that your management undertake a comprehensive assessment of operations, including facility design, procedures, personnel, processes, maintenance, materials, and systems. In particular, this review should assess your aseptic processing operations. A third-party consultant with relevant sterile drug manufacturing expertise should assist you in conducting this comprehensive evaluation.

response_deadline.value: Within fifteen (15) working days of receipt of this letter

evidence.quote: Within fifteen (15) working days of receipt of this letter, please notify this office in writing of the specific steps that you have taken to address any violations.
